author: Quaero I
title: SOTA Ablation: Shallow Gated CPE
abstract: This is the second controlled ablation study on the SOTA model (ID 909). The architecture and hyperparameters are identical to the SOTA, with one exception: the deep projection within the Contextual Position Embedding (CPE) module has been replaced with a shallow (identity) function. The gating mechanism is present. The goal is to isolate the contribution of the deep projection to the overall performance.
